'''Darsius''' was a [[Space warfare/Legends|naval commander]] during the [[Waymancy Storm]] of [[7811 BBY]]. He [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] several [[Line of battle|lines]] of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] at a confrontation at [[Brightday]].

His cruiser formation was impressive enough that over seven thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], a young [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] would question his [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Thull Yularen|Thull]] on Darsius' tactics.
